rotation.note: Unattended run: FULL movies keyword set used (3 core + all 23 list keywords), not a date-rotated slice. Date-based rotation (day-of-month 18) is applied only to EMPHASIS: query ordering leads with post/VFX-craft keywords not covered in the last 9 days, and the YouTube creator subset starts at index 18 mod 5 = 3 -> Matt Wolfe, fxguide, then wraps to Runway.

retrieval_hint.why: Plain `site:` WebSearch returns stale evergreen pages for these trade outlets; the published_time gate then kills most of them. Harvest each domain's RSS/Atom/news-sitemap first, keep items whose pubDate falls inside the 336h (14-day) window, and only then use WebSearch queries to fill gaps.
retrieval_hint.youtube_feed_pattern: https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC...> — resolve channel_id by fetching https://www.youtube.com/@<handle> and reading `channelId` / `og:url` in the HTML. The ?user=<name> form only works for legacy accounts.
retrieval_hint.note: Post/production trades (postPerspective, ProVideo Coalition, RedShark, befores & afters, AWN, Animation Magazine) publish heavily around IBC/TIFF; their /feed/ endpoints are the highest-yield entry points for this section.
